lines.text: It's cold outside.
I'll get my jacket.
Let me put it on.
Where's my other shoe?
It's by the door.
I've got my keys.
Okay, I'm ready now.
Is this the right stop?
I'm going to the station.
Which bus should I take?
Does it stop near the entrance?
Thanks. I'll wait here.
There's my bus now.
We could walk, but it looks like rain.
lines.meaning: 걸어갈 수도 있지만 비가 올 것 같아.

lines.text: Let's take the bus instead.
If we leave now, we'll still get there on time.
lines.meaning: 지금 출발하면 그래도 제시간에 도착할 수 있어.

lines.text: Does that price include delivery?
I'd rather pay a little more than pick it up myself.
lines.meaning: 직접 가지러 가느니 돈을 조금 더 내겠어요.

lines.text: Could you give me the total before I decide?
lines.meaning: 결정하기 전에 총금액을 알려 주실 수 있나요?

lines.text: I may have given you the wrong impression.
lines.meaning: 제가 잘못된 인상을 드렸을 수도 있겠네요.

lines.text: I'm not against the idea.
I just don't want us to commit before we've checked the cost.
lines.meaning: 다만 비용을 확인하기 전에 우리가 결정부터 내리지는 않았으면 해요.

lines.text: If you're asking whether I'd do it again, probably not.
lines.meaning: 다시 할 생각이 있느냐고 물으신다면, 아마 안 할 것 같아요.

lines.text: That said, I wouldn't call it a mistake. It just wasn't worth the hassle.
lines.meaning: 그렇다고 실수였다고 하진 않겠어요. 다만 그 번거로움을 감수할 만큼의 가치는 없었죠.

lines.text: Where are my glasses?
They're on the table.
Not those. The black ones.
Look next to the lamp.
Oh, here they are.
Can you pass them to me?
Thanks. I can see now.
I'm here to pick up a package.
It should be under my name.
Here's my ID.
Is this the only one?
I'm expecting a small box, too.
I'll check again tomorrow.
I'm running late because the train stopped.
Could we meet twenty minutes later?
If that doesn't work, I'll catch up with you there.
lines.meaning: 그게 어려우면 제가 나중에 그쪽으로 갈게요.

lines.text: Would it be possible to move somewhere quieter?
lines.meaning: 좀 더 조용한 자리로 옮길 수 있을까요?

lines.text: We don't mind waiting a few minutes.
A table away from the speakers would be great.
My understanding was that parking was included.
Could you check that before I pay?
lines.meaning: 결제하기 전에 확인해 주실 수 있을까요?

lines.text: I may have misread the confirmation.
lines.meaning: 제가 예약 확인 내용을 잘못 읽었을 수도 있어요.

lines.text: The delay was frustrating, but the repair itself was solid.
lines.meaning: 늦어진 건 답답했지만, 수리 자체는 제대로 됐어요.

lines.text: I just wish they'd been upfront about the wait.
lines.meaning: 다만 얼마나 기다려야 하는지 처음부터 솔직하게 알려줬으면 좋았겠어요.

lines.text: Is there any coffee left?
Just a little.
Can I have some?
Here's a clean cup.
No sugar for me, thanks.
This is really hot.
I'll wait a minute.
I'd like to return this shirt.
It's too tight around the shoulders.
I still have the receipt.
Can I get a refund?
I paid with this card.
How long does the refund take?
I need somewhere quiet for a call.
The cafe gets loud around noon.
Let's try the library if there's a room available.
lines.meaning: 이용할 수 있는 방이 있으면 도서관으로 가봐요.

lines.text: I'd like to help, but I'm at capacity today.
lines.meaning: 돕고 싶지만, 오늘은 더 맡을 여력이 없어요.

lines.text: Could we leave it until tomorrow?
If it's urgent, we may need someone else.
lines.meaning: 급한 일이면 다른 사람에게 부탁해야 할 것 같아요.

lines.text: I was floating an idea, not making a decision.
lines.meaning: 결정한 게 아니라, 아이디어를 한번 꺼내본 거예요.

lines.text: Let's see what everyone thinks first.
We don't need to settle this today.
lines.meaning: 오늘 꼭 결론을 낼 필요는 없어요.

lines.text: I'd appreciate a ride, but please don't rearrange your day for me.
lines.meaning: 태워주면 고맙겠지만, 저 때문에 하루 일정을 바꾸지는 마세요.

lines.text: If it's out of your way, I'll figure something else out.
lines.meaning: 가는 길에서 벗어나는 거면, 제가 다른 방법을 찾아볼게요.

lines.text: Hi! Come on in.
You can leave your shoes here.
Let me take your coat.
Would you like some water?
Have a seat.
I'll be right back.
Make yourself at home.
Is this the main entrance?
I'm looking for the front desk.
Do I go through this door?
The sign says it's closed.
Is there another way in?
Okay, I'll go around the building.
I ordered the small one, but this looks larger.
lines.meaning: 작은 걸 주문했는데, 이건 더 커 보이네요.

lines.text: Could you check the order for me?
lines.meaning: 주문 내용을 확인해 주실 수 있을까요?

lines.text: I'd like the size I originally asked for.
Just checking whether you saw my message.
No rush if you're still thinking it over.
lines.meaning: 아직 생각 중이시면 서두르지 않으셔도 돼요.

lines.text: A quick update by Friday would help.
lines.meaning: 금요일까지 짧게라도 알려주시면 도움이 될 것 같아요.

lines.text: I can see why you read it that way.
I took it as a suggestion, rather than a rule.
Which part made it sound definite?
I wouldn't read too much into how quiet I was.
lines.meaning: 제가 조용했다고 해서 너무 큰 의미를 두지는 마세요.

lines.text: I was taking it all in, not wishing I was somewhere else.
lines.meaning: 다른 데 가고 싶었던 게 아니라, 그 자리에서 보고 듣는 걸 찬찬히 받아들이고 있었어요.

lines.text: My phone's almost dead.
Do you have a charger?
Can I borrow it?
The outlet's over there.
This cable is too short.
I'll sit here.
I'll give it back soon.
Do you have any openings today?
I just need a haircut.
Is three thirty available?
How long will it take?
I need to leave by four.
Great. I'll be there on time.
Traffic gets heavy after five.
We should leave a little earlier.
If you're not ready, I can pack the car.
lines.meaning: 아직 준비가 안 됐으면 제가 짐을 차에 실을게요.

lines.text: Can I cancel without paying a fee?
I'd rather try one month before committing.
lines.meaning: 계속 이용할지 정하기 전에 한 달만 써보고 싶어요.

lines.text: Does it renew automatically?
I'm less concerned about who missed it than what happens next.
lines.meaning: 누가 놓쳤는지보다는 다음에 어떻게 할지가 더 중요해요.

lines.text: Can we agree on a backup plan?
That would make this easier next time.
lines.meaning: 그러면 다음에는 일이 좀 더 수월해질 거예요.

lines.text: I'm not questioning your intentions. I just need a firm date.
lines.meaning: 의도를 의심하는 게 아니에요. 확정된 날짜가 필요할 뿐이에요.

lines.text: Until we have one, I'd rather keep my options open.
lines.meaning: 날짜가 정해지기 전까지는 다른 선택지도 남겨두고 싶어요.

lines.text: It's hot in here.
Want me to open a window?
This one won't open. Let's try the other one.
lines.meaning: 이 창문은 안 열리네. 다른 창문으로 해 보자.

lines.text: There we go. Is that better?
Are you ready to go?
Almost. I'm looking for my keys.
lines.meaning: 거의 다 됐어. 열쇠를 찾고 있어.

lines.text: They're on the table.
Found them. Let's go.
Which bin is for bottles?
The blue one.
This bottle too?
Yes. Put it in there.
I won't be home when the package arrives.
lines.meaning: 택배가 도착할 때 집에 없을 것 같아요.

lines.text: Would tomorrow work instead?
Yes, after ten is best for me.
lines.meaning: 네, 저는 열 시 이후가 가장 괜찮아요.

lines.text: I'll call you when I'm nearby.
I can bring a big salad if you have the main dish covered.
lines.meaning: 네가 메인 요리를 맡아 준다면, 나는 큰 샐러드를 가져갈게.

lines.text: That works. We still need something people can drink.
lines.meaning: 좋아. 사람들이 마실 것도 아직 필요해.

lines.text: I'll pick up sparkling water on my way over.
Could you grab paper plates, too?
lines.meaning: 종이 접시도 챙겨 줄 수 있어?

lines.text: Sure. I'll check how many people are coming first.
lines.meaning: 그럼. 먼저 몇 명 오는지 확인해 볼게.

lines.text: Great. That way we won't end up with too much food.
lines.meaning: 좋아. 그러면 음식이 너무 많이 남는 일은 없겠네.

lines.text: I'm leaning toward the cheaper model, but I'd like a second opinion.
lines.meaning: 저렴한 모델 쪽으로 마음이 기울기는 하는데, 다른 사람 의견도 들어보고 싶어.

lines.text: What matters more to you: the extra features or the lower price?
lines.meaning: 추가 기능과 낮은 가격 중에 뭐가 더 중요해?

lines.text: Honestly, I probably wouldn't use half of those settings.
lines.meaning: 솔직히 말하면 저 기능 중 절반도 안 쓸 것 같아.

lines.text: Then the basic one may be the better fit, even if it isn't as flashy.
lines.meaning: 그렇다면 눈에 확 띄지는 않더라도 기본형이 더 잘 맞을 수 있겠네.

lines.text: That's what I was thinking. I just didn't want to miss something important.
lines.meaning: 나도 그렇게 생각했어. 중요한 걸 놓치고 싶지 않았던 거야.

lines.text: Check the warranty before you decide; that's where the prices differ.
lines.meaning: 결정하기 전에 보증 기간을 확인해 봐. 거기서 가격 차이가 나거든.

lines.text: Is Friday a firm deadline, or simply the date we're aiming for?
lines.meaning: 금요일이 확정 마감일인가요, 아니면 일단 목표로 잡은 날짜인가요?

lines.text: It's a target; the review can move to Monday if we need the time.
lines.meaning: 목표일일 뿐이에요. 시간이 더 필요하면 검토 일정은 월요일로 미뤄도 됩니다.

lines.text: That helps. I'll focus on the sections that need the most coordination first.
lines.meaning: 알겠습니다. 우선 조율이 가장 많이 필요한 부분부터 집중할게요.

lines.text: Please flag anything that could change the timeline, and we'll adjust early.
lines.meaning: 일정에 영향을 줄 수 있는 사항이 있으면 바로 표시해 주세요. 그러면 미리 조정할 수 있어요.

lines.text: I'm open to a trial, as long as we cap the time and make the trade-offs explicit.
lines.meaning: 시험 운영은 해볼 의향이 있어요. 다만 기간을 제한하고, 그 과정에서 무엇을 얻고 포기해야 하는지 명확히 해야 해요.

lines.text: Agreed. A promising first run doesn't prove the approach will hold up at scale.
lines.meaning: 동의해요. 첫 시도에서 좋은 결과가 나왔다고 해서 규모를 확대했을 때도 같은 방식이 효과적일 거라는 보장은 없으니까요.

lines.text: Let's define what success would look like before we commit more resources.
lines.meaning: 더 많은 자원을 투입하기 전에 무엇을 성공으로 볼지부터 정해 보죠.

lines.text: Are you ready to go?
Almost. I can't find my keys.
Did you check the little table by the door?
Here they are. Let's go.
This street is closed, so we'll have to take another way.
lines.meaning: 이 길은 막혀 있어서 다른 길로 가야겠어.

lines.text: The map shows a path behind the library.
Is it much farther than the main road?
lines.meaning: 큰길로 가는 것보다 많이 더 멀어?

lines.text: Only a few minutes, and it looks quieter.
lines.meaning: 몇 분 더 걸릴 뿐이고, 더 한적해 보여.

lines.text: Let's take it, then. We don't need to rush.
lines.meaning: 그럼 그 길로 가자. 서두를 필요는 없으니까.

lines.text: Good call. I'll keep the map open until we get there.
lines.meaning: 좋은 생각이야. 도착할 때까지 지도를 켜 둘게.

lines.text: You've put a lot of thought into these slides.
lines.meaning: 이 슬라이드에 정말 많은 고민을 담으셨네요.

lines.text: Thanks. I wanted to make sure we covered every detail.
lines.meaning: 고마워요. 빠뜨리는 내용이 없도록 하고 싶었어요.

lines.text: Would you be open to trimming a few sections so the main point stands out?
lines.meaning: 핵심이 더 잘 드러나도록 몇 부분을 덜어내 보는 건 어떨까요?

lines.text: I could do that, though I don't want the background to disappear.
lines.meaning: 그렇게 할 수는 있지만, 배경 설명이 너무 빠지지는 않았으면 해요.

lines.text: Maybe we can move the extra context to the handout.
lines.meaning: 추가 배경 설명은 유인물로 옮기면 어떨까요?

lines.text: That sounds reasonable. Let's try it and see how the flow feels.
lines.meaning: 괜찮은 생각이네요. 그렇게 해 보고 흐름이 어떤지 살펴보죠.

lines.text: I'd prefer the earlier train, but I don't need it if the later one gets us there on time.
lines.meaning: 더 이른 열차를 타면 좋겠지만, 늦은 열차로도 제시간에 도착한다면 꼭 그럴 필요는 없어요.

lines.text: So the arrival time is the requirement; the departure time is just your preference.
lines.meaning: 그러면 도착 시각은 필수 조건이고, 출발 시각은 선호에 가깝군요.

lines.text: Exactly. That distinction gives us more room to find a fare that works for both of us.
lines.meaning: 맞아요. 그렇게 구분하면 우리 둘 다에게 맞는 요금을 찾을 여지가 더 생겨요.

lines.text: Let's compare the options against what we actually need, not what we'd ideally choose.
lines.meaning: 이상적으로 고를 것을 기준으로 하지 말고, 실제로 필요한 조건을 기준으로 선택지를 비교해 봅시다.

lines.text: The evening felt welcoming, especially for people who'd never joined us before.
lines.meaning: 오늘 저녁 모임은 특히 처음 오신 분들도 편하게 느끼셨을 것 같아요.

lines.text: I'm glad. We could still smooth out the check-in, which backed up near the entrance.
lines.meaning: 다행이네요. 다만 입구 쪽에서 밀렸던 접수 절차는 다음에 더 매끄럽게 다듬을 수 있겠어요.

lines.text: Good point. If we add one volunteer there, we can keep the warm atmosphere without the bottleneck.
lines.meaning: 좋은 지적이에요. 그곳에 자원봉사자를 한 명 더 두면 줄이 막히지 않으면서도 편안한 분위기를 유지할 수 있겠어요.

lines.text: I need to make another appointment.
We have an opening on Thursday morning.
Could I come in after lunch instead?
Yes. How about two thirty?
Before we head out, do you have the tickets on your phone?
lines.meaning: 나가기 전에 휴대폰에 표 저장해 뒀어?

lines.text: Yes, and I saved a screenshot in case the signal drops.
lines.meaning: 응, 통신이 안 될 경우에 대비해 화면도 캡처해 뒀어.

lines.text: Nice. I've got the keys, but my battery is almost dead.
lines.meaning: 잘했네. 열쇠는 챙겼는데 배터리가 거의 다 됐어.

lines.text: Take the small charger from the counter; it's fully charged.
lines.meaning: 조리대에 있는 작은 보조배터리 가져가. 충전이 다 돼 있어.

lines.text: Thanks. I'll put it in the front pocket so I can find it.
lines.meaning: 고마워. 바로 찾을 수 있게 앞주머니에 넣어 둘게.

lines.text: All set. Let's lock up and get going.
We could eat outside if the weather holds.
lines.meaning: 날씨가 계속 괜찮으면 밖에서 먹어도 좋겠어.

lines.text: The forecast is a bit uncertain, though.
Let's keep the reservation inside and decide when we get there.
lines.meaning: 일단 실내 예약은 유지하고 도착해서 결정하자.

lines.text: Would they let us move to the patio if it clears up?
lines.meaning: 날이 개면 야외 자리로 옮길 수 있을까?

lines.text: I can call and check before we leave.
lines.meaning: 출발하기 전에 내가 전화해서 확인해 볼게.

lines.text: Perfect. That gives us options without making extra work.
lines.meaning: 좋아. 그러면 번거롭게 따로 준비하지 않고도 선택지를 남겨 둘 수 있겠네.

lines.text: I can get behind the proposal, though I can't promise a full draft by Friday.
lines.meaning: 그 제안을 지지할 수는 있지만, 금요일까지 완성된 초안을 낼 수 있다고 장담할 수는 없어요.

lines.text: What could you realistically finish by then?
lines.meaning: 현실적으로 그때까지 어디까지 마칠 수 있나요?

lines.text: I can outline the key sections and flag the decisions we still need to make.
lines.meaning: 핵심 부분의 개요를 잡고, 아직 결정해야 할 사항을 표시할 수 있어요.

lines.text: That would give us enough to move forward without setting the wrong expectation.
lines.meaning: 그 정도면 잘못된 기대를 갖게 하지 않고도 다음 단계로 넘어갈 수 있겠네요.

lines.text: I need to revise what I said about Saturday; a family commitment came up.
lines.meaning: 토요일 일정에 관해 말씀드린 내용을 바꿔야 할 것 같아요. 가족 관련 일정이 생겼어요.

lines.text: Thanks for telling me now. I was counting on you to help set things up.
lines.meaning: 지금 알려줘서 고마워. 네가 준비를 도와줄 거라고 생각하고 있었거든.

lines.text: I understand, and I'm sorry for the change. I can come by Friday evening to get things ready.
lines.meaning: 그럴 만한 사정이라는 건 이해해요. 일정이 바뀌게 되어 미안해요. 금요일 저녁에 들러 미리 준비해 둘 수 있어요.

lines.text: That would help a lot. We'll adjust the Saturday plan around it.
lines.meaning: 그러면 정말 큰 도움이 돼. 그에 맞춰 토요일 계획을 조정할게.
